# Brotli differential corpus — provenance

Generated by `scripts/build-brotli-vectors.py <google/brotli checkout>` (block typeface plan, Task 1)
with the brotli 1.2.0 Python module (the C reference encoder and decoder). The checkout must be at
`42a2ed4355bc6287da6bb6319f090b499cba4550`, the commit `core/src/Content/Fonts/Brotli/Port/` is
ported from. Every entry records upstream's outcome — the output's length and SHA-256, or `error` —
and `tests/Unit/Fonts/BrotliDifferentialTest.php` requires the port to produce the same outcome.

| path | contents |
|---|---|
| `upstream/`, `upstream.json` | every `tests/testdata/*.compressed*` stream at the pinned commit (MIT, `upstream/LICENSE`), with upstream's own expected output; the C decoder agrees with each |
| `synth.json` | `java/org/brotli/dec/SynthTest.java`'s 45 enabled vectors: the stream, and the expected output (or failure) |
| `generated/`, `generated.json` | C-encoder streams: dictionary words and transforms (text and generic modes, UTF-8), overlapping copies (periods 1–100), window sizes 10–24 with a copy at exactly the largest distance (`.edge`) and one byte past it (`.past`), random data (uncompressed meta-blocks), several meta-blocks, and font mode |
| `mutated.json` | 6,042 truncations, bit flips and byte overwrites of 11 base streams, recorded as operations (`truncate`, `flip`, `set`) with the C decoder's verdict |
| `max-trees.br` | a hand-built stream whose headers declare 256 block types and 256 trees for every category, then ends — the allocation probe's malformed-header case |
